column1: What are you doing in my courtroom? You're not on my docket. Get out of here and stop wasting taxpayers' money!
column2: 你在我的法庭裡做什麼？你根本不在我的排期上。給我出去，別再浪費納稅人的錢了！

column1: ...and although a jury of your peers has found you innocent, young man, my personal opinion is that your actions are absolutely unforgiveable. Rest assured that if I ever see you in this courtroom again, I'll throw the book at you.
column2: ……儘管由你的同儕組成的陪審團判你無罪，年輕人，但我個人認為你的所作所為完全不可原諒。你放心，要是讓我再看到你出現在這個法庭上，我一定會用最重的罪名辦你。

column1: I'm not talking Robert's Rules of Order here. I'm talking the entire Encyclopedia. Do you understand me?
column2: 我說的可不是《羅伯特議事規則》那種小兒科。我說的是整套百科全書等級的規矩。你聽懂了嗎？

column1: Your Honor, I--
column2: 庭上，我——

column1: Good. I'm glad we understand each other. Remember, one misstep, and you've HAD IT!
column2: 很好。很高興我們彼此理解。記住，只要走錯一步，你就完了！

column1: BONDS?!
column2: BONDS？！

column1: You have no business being here, Officer. You're just wasting my time. Get out of here. NOW!
column2: 你沒有理由出現在這裡，警員。你只是在浪費我的時間。給我出去。馬上！

column1: ...Couldn't make it? Your star witness couldn't make it? Why, because he didn't want to miss the game this afternoon? NO! I will not grant you an extension for that, Counselor. If you can't control your own witnesses--
column2: ……來不了？你的王牌證人來不了？為什麼，因為他不想錯過今天下午的球賽嗎？不行！我不會因為這種理由准你延期的，律師。如果你連自己的證人都管不住——

column1: Bonds, I am not in a good mood. Get out of my courtroom and stop wasting taxpayer's money before I hold you in contempt of court. SO GET OUT OF HERE! NOW!!!
column2: Bonds，我現在心情不好。趁我還沒以藐視法庭罪名辦你之前，滾出我的法庭，別再浪費納稅人的錢了。所以給我出去！馬上！！！

column1: ...I hereby sentence you to 30 days in the County prison plus a $5,000 fine. And if I were you, young man, I'd find myself a new attorney.
column2: ……本席在此判處你郡立監獄拘役 30 天，外加罰款 5,000 美元。年輕人，要是我是你，我會另外找個律師。

column1: Your honor, I must object! My client has been victimized by a system whose...
column2: 庭上，我必須提出異議！我的當事人是這套體制下的受害者，而這套體制……

column1: As for you, Mister, I highly suggest you review your rules of evidence before you appear in this courtroom again. I will NOT have my time wasted with spurious accusations for which you have no evidence, objections for which you have no grounds, and constant badgering of the witnesses.
column2: 至於你，先生，我強烈建議你在下次踏進這個法庭之前，先把證據規則重新讀熟。我絕不容許你用毫無證據的指控、毫無根據的異議，以及沒完沒了地騷擾證人來浪費我的時間。

column1: Now...what do you want, Detective?
column2: 好了……你想幹嘛，警探？

column1: He's talking to you, Bonds. You'd better be careful. Richard Palmer is just about the toughest judge in the state of California.
column2: 他在跟你說話，Bonds。你最好小心點。Richard Palmer 大概是加州最嚴厲的法官了。

column1: Bonds, I don't have all day.
column2: Bonds，我沒有那麼多時間跟你耗。

column1: Bonds, I have no time for people who have no respect. Get out of my courtroom.
column2: Bonds，我沒空理不懂得尊重人的傢伙。滾出我的法庭。

column1: You're this close to being held in contempt of court, Bonds. GO!!!
column2: Bonds，你現在離藐視法庭只差這麼一點點。快滾！！！

column1: You don't need to testify on the stand, Bonds.
column2: Bonds，你不需要站上證人席作證。

column1: It's the witness stand. You've sat here a few hundred times in your days as a patrolman.
column2: 這是證人席。你當巡警的那些日子裡，已經在這裡坐過幾百次了。

column1: Please don't squeeze the suspect.
column2: 請別捏嫌犯。

column1: It's one of the defendants on Palmer's docket. Whoever he is, he's lucky; Palmer talks loud but has a gentle touch.
column2: 這是 Palmer 排期上的其中一名被告。不管他是誰，他都算走運；Palmer 嗓門大，下手可輕得很。

column1: You've got nothing to say to this guy.
column2: 你沒什麼話要跟這傢伙說。

column1: Adjust Judge Palmer's windows, Bonds, and he might just adjust YOU.
column2: Bonds，敢動 Palmer 法官的窗戶，他可能就換成「調整」你了。

column1: The windows look out over the Courthouse lawn.
column2: 這扇窗俯瞰著法院的草坪。

column1: Unhand that officer!
column2: 放開那位警員！

column1: Don't you have to be somewhere, Bonds?
column2: Bonds，你不是該去別的地方了嗎？

column1: Gotta run, Sonny.
column2: 我得走了，Sonny。

column1: You don't have time for idle chit-chat.
column2: 你沒空閒聊。

column1: Bye, Sonny.
column2: 再見，Sonny。

column1: The officer is busy.
column2: 這位警員正忙著。

column1: Aren't you supposed to be somewhere, Bonds?
column2: Bonds，你不是該去某個地方嗎？

column1: Why are you lurking in the halls, Bonds? Get to work!
column2: Bonds，你幹嘛在走廊上鬼鬼祟祟的？快去工作！

column1: You again. Hmmph.
column2: 又是你。哼。

column1: Hello, Bonds.
column2: 哈囉，Bonds。

column1: Damn Gremlin. I'll kill him. Whoever he is, I'll kill him.
column2: 該死的 Gremlin。我要殺了他。不管他是誰，我都要殺了他。

column1: It's Sgt. Dooley.
column2: 這是 Dooley 警佐。

column1: It's always best to leave cranky Sergeants alone.
column2: 心情不好的警佐，最好別去招惹。

column1: Considering the mood Sgt. Dooley has been in for the last several days, I'd leave him alone if I were you.
column2: 考慮到 Dooley 警佐這幾天的心情，換作是你，我會離他遠一點。

column1: Hey, Sonny, you'd better hurry or Dooley's gonna fry your bacon for being late for the briefing.
column2: 嘿，Sonny，你最好快點，不然簡報遲到，Dooley 會把你電得死去活來。

column1: Hi, Sonny! Did you hear Sam got tranferred to Coarsegold? Bummer, huh?
column2: 嗨，Sonny！你聽說了嗎，Sam 被調去 Coarsegold 了？真衰，對吧？

column1: Hey, it's the Sonny-meister!
column2: 嘿，這不是 Sonny 大師嗎！

column1: How's it going, Sonny? Cleaned up Lytton yet? ha ha.
column2: 最近怎樣，Sonny？把 Lytton 整頓乾淨了沒？哈哈。

column1: Hey, Sonny, I'll give you a call this weekend.
column2: 嘿，Sonny，這個週末我打給你。

column1: Hey, wake up! You're thinkin' too hard!
column2: 嘿，醒醒！你想太多了！

column1: Oh, man, I'm late. Dooley's gonna kill me.
column2: 喔，慘了，我遲到了。Dooley 會宰了我。

column1: Smile, Sonny!
column2: 笑一個，Sonny！

column1: Sonny, wasn't the Gremlin's last joke awesome? Ha ha!
column2: Sonny，Gremlin 上次那個惡作劇是不是超讚？哈哈！

column1: Earth to Sonny, Earth to Sonny! You were lookin' a little spacey there, ha ha!
column2: 呼叫 Sonny，呼叫 Sonny！你剛剛看起來有點神遊，哈哈！

column1: Sonny, did you see the game last night? That's the way to do it, man. Get paid five million a year to kick a little ball around, ha ha!
column2: Sonny，你昨晚看比賽了嗎？這才是人生贏家的玩法。踢踢小球一年就能賺五百萬，哈哈！

column1: Hey, Bonds, did you double your quota again this week? What an overachiever, man!
column2: 嘿，Bonds，你這禮拜業績又是雙倍了嗎？真是個工作狂啊！

column1: Hey, Sonny! When are you gonna get a girlfriend, ha ha!
column2: 嘿，Sonny！你到底什麼時候才要交個女朋友啊，哈哈！

column1: Oh, geez, Dooley had a cow over his "customized" pink uniform. The Gremlin strikes again, ay, Sonny? Ha ha!
column2: 喔，天啊，Dooley 為了他那件「客製化」的粉紅制服氣炸了。Gremlin 又出手了，是吧，Sonny？哈哈！

column1: Oh, my baby lives in Bootjack, she's the apple of my eye And if my baby left me, I'd blow a lung and die. She hugs me in the morning and she kisses me at night, She makes me roadkill pancakes, And she's vicious in a fight.
column2: 喔，我的寶貝住在 Bootjack，她是我的掌上明珠，要是她離開我，我肯定會活活氣斷氣。她早上抱我，晚上吻我，她會煮路殺動物做成的鬆餅給我吃，她打起架來還挺兇的。

column1: One of your fellow officers.
column2: 你的一位同事警員。

column1: Oh, hi, Sonny.
column2: 喔，嗨，Sonny。

column1: Hi, Sonny. Be careful today, okay?
column2: 嗨，Sonny。今天小心點，好嗎？

column1: Don't get old, Sonny, it's not worth it.
column2: 別變老啊，Sonny，不划算的。

column1: It's Officer Jack Cobb.
column2: 這是 Jack Cobb 警員。

column1: Jack seems distracted lately. You're a little worried about him.
column2: Jack 最近似乎心不在焉。你有點擔心他。

column1: You answer Jack, but he doesn't seem to hear you.
column2: 你回應了 Jack，但他似乎沒聽見。

column1: Hello, Bonds. Nice to see you.
column2: 你好，Bonds。很高興見到你。

column1: Keep up the good work, Bonds.
column2: 繼續保持，Bonds。

column1: Hello, Sonny.
column2: 你好，Sonny。

column1: I hear good things about you, Bonds.
column2: 我聽到不少關於你的好消息，Bonds。

column1: It's Lt. Morgan.
column2: 這是 Morgan 中尉。

column1: You politely reply. Lt. Morgan is definitely a good guy, you think to yourself.
column2: 你禮貌地回應。你心想，Morgan 中尉確實是個好人。

column1: You politely answer Lt. Morgan.
column2: 你禮貌地回答 Morgan 中尉。

column1: What, did you expect yourself to answer? You've been working too hard, Bonds.
column2: 怎麼，你還期待自己會回答自己嗎？Bonds，你工作太累了。

column1: You get a busy signal.
column2: 你聽到忙線音。

column1: This is Sergeant John Dooley. Leave your name and message at the tone. And if this is The Gremlin, YOU'RE DEAD! **BEEP*
column2: 這是 John Dooley 警佐。請在嗶聲後留下姓名與留言。要是你是 Gremlin，你死定了！**嗶*

column1: Yikes! You decide not to leave a message.
column2: 哎呀！你決定不留言了。

column1: Hmmm, no answer.
column2: 嗯，沒人接。

column1: Hi, this is Officer Fudley Morris. I can't come to the phone right now. I'm cleaning up the streets. Leave your number and I'll call you back. **BEEP*
column2: 嗨，這是 Fudley Morris 警員。我現在沒辦法接電話，我正在整頓街頭。留下你的電話號碼，我會回你電話。**嗶*

column1: Cleaning up the streets? Yeah, right. You'd bet 20 to 1 that Fudley's cleaning himself in the shower. Fudley's always in the shower.
column2: 整頓街頭？是啦，才怪。你敢賭二十比一，Fudley 現在肯定在浴室裡沖洗自己。Fudley 老是窩在浴室裡。

column1: There's no answer right now.
column2: 現在沒人接聽。

column1: ...Hello?
Jack, this is Sonny.
column2: Jack，我是 Sonny。

column1: Oh...Sonny. Listen, I don't really feel like talking...
column2: 喔……Sonny。聽著，我現在不太想說話……

column1: I know, Jack. I just wanted to tell you...that I'm sorry. If there's anything I can do for you, Jack, anything at all, just let me know.
column2: 我知道，Jack。我只是想跟你說……我很遺憾。如果有什麼我能幫上忙的，Jack，什麼都可以，跟我說一聲就行。

column1: Thank you, Sonny, that means a lot to me. There's nothing I can think of. But thanks anyway.
column2: 謝謝你，Sonny，這對我意義重大。我一時想不到有什麼需要的。但還是謝謝你。

column1: Sure. Call me if you need me, okay?
column2: 沒問題。有需要就打給我，好嗎？

column1: Okay. Goodbye, Sonny.
column2: 好。再見，Sonny。

column1: Goodbye, Jack.
column2: 再見，Jack。

column1: That was just about the most difficult phone call you ever made in your life. You're glad you did, though. You wanted Jack to know you were thinking of him.
column2: 那大概是你這輩子打過最艱難的一通電話。不過你還是很慶幸自己打了。你希望 Jack 知道，你一直惦記著他。

column1: You suddenly remember the time that Keith had to call the parents of a young 11-44. You realize that you probably have many more terribly hard phone calls to make in your career. You try not to think about it. They make you sick to your stomach.
column2: 你忽然想起 Keith 曾經打電話通知一名年輕 11-44 死者的父母那次。你意識到，在你的警察生涯裡，恐怕還有更多這種艱難無比的電話要打。你試著不去多想。光想到就讓你反胃。

column1: You get only a busy signal.
column2: 你只聽到忙線音。

column1: This is Jake Donaldson. I'm on vacation this week. Leave a message if it's important. If you call me at my hotel in San Diego, it had better be a life and death matter. I'm busy soakin' up rays! **BEEP*
column2: 這是 Jake Donaldson。我這禮拜在度假。有重要的事再留言。要是你打到我在 San Diego 的飯店找我，最好是攸關生死的大事。我正忙著曬太陽呢！**嗶*

column1: You decide to leave Jake in peace.
column2: 你決定讓 Jake 安靜度假，不打擾他。

column1: This is Detective Jeff Steele. I can't come to the phone right now. I'm sure I have a very good reason. If you have a very good reason, leave your name and message at the beep. **BEEP*
column2: 這是 Jeff Steele 警探。我現在沒辦法接電話。我相信自己一定有個很充分的理由。如果你也有很充分的理由，請在嗶聲後留下姓名與留言。**嗶*

column1: You don't have a good reason to talk to Detective Steele, so you hang up.
column2: 你沒有充分的理由要找 Steele 警探談，所以你掛斷了電話。

column1: Hi, this is Keith Mandel. I'm out making Lytton safe for future generations, so please leave your message and I'll call you back. **BEEP*
column2: 嗨，這是 Keith Mandel。我正在外面為子孫後代把 Lytton 變得更安全，請留言，我會回電給你。**嗶*

column1: Keith, this is Sonny. I'm sure the criminals are quaking with fear at the sound of your name by now. Call me if you want to go for pizza this weekend. Bye.
column2: Keith，我是 Sonny。我猜現在罪犯只要聽到你的名字都嚇得發抖了吧。這週末想吃披薩的話打給我。掰。

column1: Hi, this is Officer Kurt Wolff. I'm probably out risking my life over a domestic dispute involving who drank the last of the orange juice, or who left the toilet seat up. Leave your name and number. If I live through the day, I'll call you. **BEEP*
column2: 嗨，這是 Kurt Wolff 警員。我大概正在外面冒著生命危險，處理誰喝光最後一杯柳橙汁、或誰沒把馬桶蓋放下來之類的家庭糾紛。留下你的姓名和電話。要是我能活著撐過今天，我會回你電話。**嗶*

column1: Hmm, Kurt always did have a strange sense of humor.
column2: 嗯，Kurt 的幽默感一向都很奇怪。

column1: Hi, this is Officer Miranda Duvall. I'm out saving the world right now, so obviously, I can't come to the phone. If you need a natural disaster averted, leave your name and message and I'll get back to you. **BEEP*
column2: 嗨，這是 Miranda Duvall 警員。我現在正在外面拯救世界，所以顯然沒辦法接電話。如果你需要阻止一場天災，請留下姓名與留言，我會回你電話。**嗶*

column1: Hmm, great message!
column2: 嗯，這留言真棒！

column1: You get a busy signal. Captain Morgan has to spend a lot of time on the phone.
column2: 你聽到忙線音。Morgan 隊長顯然得花很多時間講電話。

column1: Hello, this is Detective Oliver Smith. I'm out improving my skills with a firearm at the firing range. I would suggest you get off your butt and do so as well. If you have something to say to me, leave a message at the tone. **BEEP*
column2: 你好，這是 Oliver Smith 警探。我正在靶場精進槍法。我建議你也起身動一動，去練練槍。如果你有話跟我說，請在嗶聲後留言。**嗶*

column1: You don't have anything to say to Detective Smith, so you hang up.
column2: 你沒什麼話要跟 Smith 警探說，所以你掛斷了電話。

column1: This is Detective Oscar Hamiliton. I'm out scraping some poor shlock off the sidewalk right now, so I can't come to the phone. If it's important, leave me a message. If it's not, leave me the hell alone.
column2: 這是 Oscar Hamilton 警探。我現在正在外面把某個可憐蟲從人行道上刮起來，所以沒辦法接電話。要是有重要的事，留言給我。不重要的話，別來煩我。

column1: *BEEP*
You wisely decide not to disturb the Detective.
column2: 你很明智地決定不去打擾這位警探。

column1: This is Officer Billings. I can't come to the phone right now. If you're the creep who bashed the fender of my vintage Jag, leave your name and number at the tone. Believe me, I'll get back to you. **BEEP**
column2: 這是 Billings 警員。我現在沒辦法接電話。如果你就是撞凹我那台古董 Jag 車頭板的死小子，請在嗶聲後留下姓名和電話。相信我，我一定會回你電話。**嗶**

column1: You don't need to say anything to Officer Billings, so you hang up.
column2: 你沒必要跟 Billings 警員說什麼，所以你掛斷了電話。

column1: Hi, Little Buckaroo, this is Officer Paul Peterowski at your service. I'm not really at your service, because I'm not here right now! Leave a message, or come down to the jail and see me. I'm dying for some company! That means you, Sonny Bonds! **BEEP*
column2: 嗨，小牛仔，這是 Paul Peterowski 警員為您服務。其實我沒辦法為你服務，因為我現在不在！留個言，或者直接來監獄看我。我快悶死了，超想有人陪！說的就是你，Sonny Bonds！**嗶*

column1: Cringing inwardly, you hang up.
column2: 你內心一陣尷尬，掛斷了電話。

column1: The number you have dialed cannot be reached from your calling area. Thank you for using LT&T.
column2: 您撥的號碼在您所在的區域無法接通。感謝您使用 LT&T。

column1: That number seems to be busy.
column2: 那個號碼似乎在忙線中。

column1: You don't need to repeat that call.
column2: 你不需要再打一次那通電話。

column1: Against your better judgment, you dial the emergency number. After a few seconds, the dispatcher answers your call.
column2: 儘管明知不太妥當，你還是撥了緊急電話號碼。幾秒鐘後，調度員接起了你的電話。

column1: She informs you curtly that you cannot be transferred to Lieutenant Morgan from this line, and reminds you that 911 is strictly for emergencies.
column2: 她語氣冷淡地告訴你，這條線無法轉接給 Morgan 中尉，並提醒你 911 專門用於緊急狀況。

column1: Unfortunately, you know she's right, and you apologize quickly before hanging up.
column2: 很遺憾，你知道她說得沒錯，於是你連忙道歉後掛斷電話。

column1: You DID remember to note Morgan's phone number before leaving the station, didn't you? That would have been just plain common sense.
column2: 你出發前確實有記下 Morgan 的電話號碼吧？這本來就是基本常識。

column1: We're sorry. Your call can not go through as dialed. Please check the number and dial again. Thank you for using LT&T.
column2: 很抱歉，您撥的號碼無法接通。請確認號碼後重新撥打。感謝您使用 LT&T。

column1: You have reached Directory Assistance. Due to a heavy volume of calls, all circuits are busy. Please try again later. Thank you for using LT&T.
column2: 您已接通查號台。由於來電量過大，目前線路全滿。請稍後再撥。感謝您使用 LT&T。

column1: We're sorry, you have reached a number that is no longer in service. If you feel you have reached this recording in error, please check the number and try your call again. Thank you for using LT&T.
column2: 很抱歉，您撥的號碼已經停用。如果您認為聽到這段錄音是誤撥，請確認號碼後重新撥打。感謝您使用 LT&T。

column1: McCall. Leave a message. **BEEP**
column2: McCall。請留言。**嗶**

column1: You decide not to leave a message.
column2: 你決定不留言。

column1: Hi, this is Russ! I'm, like, really busy right now, so, like, leave your message at the beep, and I'll have my secretary call yours, ha ha! **BEEP**
column2: 嗨，我是 Russ！我現在，呃，真的很忙，所以，呃，嗶聲後留言吧，我會叫我的秘書打給你的秘書，哈哈！**嗶**

column1: You don't have a message for Russ, so you hang up.
column2: 你沒有話要留給 Russ，所以你掛斷了電話。

column1: Hi, this is Officer Zuckerman. If you're Oprah or Phil or Sally wanting to tell the sordid story of my life, I'll call you right back. If you're anyone else, leave your number anyway, and I'll think about it! **BEEP**
column2: 嗨，這是 Zuckerman 警員。如果你是 Oprah、Phil 或 Sally，想邀我上節目大爆我那段不堪的往事，我會馬上回你電話。要是別人的話，反正也留個號碼吧，我會考慮考慮！**嗶**

column1: Sarah, this is Geraldo. I was going to have you on my program, but you got bumped by a panel of completely well-adjusted, happy straight people. Sorry, maybe next time!
column2: Sarah，我是 Geraldo。本來要請你上我的節目，但你被一群完全正常、幸福美滿的異性戀來賓給擠掉了。抱歉，也許下次吧！

column1: That'll teach her.
column2: 這下她學到教訓了。

column1: This is Officer Shelly Kale. Leave your name and number and I'll get back to you. **BEEP**
column2: 這是 Shelly Kale 警員。留下你的姓名和電話，我會回你電話。**嗶**

column1: You don't have anything to say to Officer Kale, so you hang up.
column2: 你沒什麼話要跟 Kale 警員說，所以你掛斷了電話。

column1: Hey, this is Steve. I'm busy scamming babes right now so leave me a message and I'll call you back. Bye! **BEEP**
column2: 嘿，這是 Steve。我現在正忙著把妹，留言給我，我會回電。掰！**嗶**

column1: Hey, bozo, what are you doing? Get back to your desk and finish your paperwork! Let me know if you wanna go for pizza this weekend. Bye.
column2: 嘿，笨蛋，你在幹嘛？快回你的辦公桌把文件寫完！這週末想吃披薩的話跟我說一聲。掰。

column1: That was fun!
column2: 真有趣！
